query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Zingiberene' THEN 30.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Gingerol' THEN 15.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Beta-bisabolene' THEN 8.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-curcumene' THEN 5.0
  END,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Zingiberene' THEN 'Composant majeur du gingembre'
    WHEN m.name = 'Gingerol' THEN 'Responsable du piquant'
    WHEN m.name = 'Beta-bisabolene' THEN 'Note balsamique'
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-curcumene' THEN 'Note épicée secondaire'
  END
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name = 'Gingembre' 
AND m.name IN ('Zingiberene', 'Gingerol', 'Beta-bisabolene', 'Alpha-curcumene');
